title: Drawings

empty.title: Your drawings, next to the model
empty.body: Open a DXF or a PDF, or cut a plan from the IFC. Files stay in this browser.

errors.dwg: {{name}} is a DWG (AutoCAD {{detail}}). DWG can't be opened here yet. Save it as DXF: in AutoCAD use Save As → DXF, or convert it on your computer with the free ODA File Converter, then open the DXF.
errors.dxfBinary: {{name}} is a binary DXF. Save it again as ASCII DXF and open that.
errors.notDxf: {{name}} is not a DXF or PDF this viewer can read.
errors.tooBig: {{name}} expands to too many entities to draw in a browser.
errors.pdfPassword: {{name}} is protected with a password. Remove it and try again.
errors.pdfBroken: {{name}} could not be read as a PDF: {{detail}}
errors.emptyCut: That cut goes through no geometry. Try another level or height.

hints.select: Click to select, drag to move, Delete to remove.
hints.pan: Drag to pan, wheel to zoom.
hints.polyline: Click points; double click or Enter to finish.
hints.circle: Click the centre, then the edge.
hints.dimension: Click two points to measure and label them.
hints.calibrate: Click both ends of a length you know.
hints.align: Click on this sheet, then the same spot on the reference. Twice.

noUnits: No scale yet: use Set the scale or Align.
